Vin Dorgo is a drunk patron of the The Blushing Mermaid in Baldur's Gate during Act Three.

Involvement

Act Three

Vin Dorgo is drunk and unconscious on the second floor of The Blushing Mermaid. She remains this way even if combat starts, and cannot be spoken to or interacted with.
